items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I was doing quite a bit of recording with Mildred Bailey. She kept -- she always wanted Roy, Teddy Wilson and myself with her.

ctx.x: And I might add that during this same time I was doing quite a bit of recording with Mildred Bailey. She kept -- she always wanted Roy, Teddy Wilson and myself with her. It's a marvelous dates because we did some things with I think the writer was Alec Wilder, and she did some very good things during this time. And we used to have some great parties at our house. She loved to give parties and have all the musicians over. And Kenny Clark@ I think did quite a few recordings with her at this time. Also --
